name: AIOMetadata
description: AIOMetadata is a Stremio metadata addon that aggregates movie, series and anime data from TMDB, TVDB, Fanart.tv, MyAnimeList, AniList, Trakt and more into one configurable catalog, with per-user API keys, poster proxying and cache warming.

notes.text: No provider API keys are preset. Add your TMDB/TVDB/Fanart.tv keys on the /configure page, or set the BUILT_IN_* variables in /opt/aiometadata_data/.env to cover every user.
To enable the Trakt, Simkl, AniList and MyAnimeList integrations, add their client ID and secret to /opt/aiometadata_data/.env, then restart the aiometadata service.
Use the generated ADMIN_KEY from /opt/aiometadata_data/.env to access the dashboard. Keys set directly (not BUILT_IN_*) are served to any visitor via /api/config.
